name: Crew Dragon rotation touch controls
view: a part of a flight display as the crew sees it: Crew Dragon has no rotation hand controller; the rotation commands are on-screen buttons in a group (pitch up / down, yaw left / right, roll left / right around them) pressed with a gloved finger; the drawing shows the display edge with that group
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the display and the button group reconstructed from the public Crew Dragon descriptions (SpaceX and NASA Commercial Crew overviews, the public SpaceX ISS docking simulator, Wikipedia) and public photos looked at for proportions; the exact screen layout is not confirmed. Not traced from a photo or a screenshot.
